plan: No theme this morning: the industry groups in the scan do not share a reason for the move. The clearest reasons are company earnings at BRBR, IIIV and HIHO, and HIHO and GMM carry the real premarket volume at 5.3x and 6.97x a normal day. Be careful with AKAN and GMM: tiny floats, no news, and AKAN has a High dilution flag. The scan counts 3 halts today, and BRBR and IIIV have traded very little so far.
